profile.description: Dispatch office: audible rain, quieter harbour, clock and gentle timber movement
Tide Office: rain on the window, clock, sheltered canal
Archive Vestibule: sheltered air and occasional old timber
Restoration Room: close quiet workspace, distant rainfall
Boarding House: small hearth, rain and inhabited timber
Bell Tower: open high wind, faint harbour and clockwork
Pump Court: running water with distant steam machinery
Sluice Gallery: close trickles beneath distant moving water
Machine Room: restrained steam bed and sparse gear turns
Workers’ Kitchen: hearth and muffled waterworks outside
Lockkeeper’s Cabin: sheltered water, quiet clock and timber
Spillway Overlook: broad moving water and exposed wind
Observatory Steps: open hill wind with a distant city
Transit Hall: sheltered high wind and a delicate clock
Plate Darkroom: damp hush, faint drips and old timber
Signal Loft: air through slats, intermittent mechanism
Clock Workshop: close restrained ticks and occasional gear work
Meridian Roof: exposed gusts with distant water below
Reed Jetty: wetland birds, gentle water and landing timber
Abandoned Clinic: sparse wind through shelter, fading rain
Glasshouse: birds outside the panes, drips among leaves
Survey Hut: marsh outside and a sheltered wooden frame
Memorial Garden: soft air and unhurried garden birds
Island Refuge: warm hearth, quiet rain and distant reeds
Civic Square: open civic air, birds and distant canal
Council Chamber: hushed hall, faint clock and timber
Deed Vault: still sheltered air, occasional structural creak
Print Shop: low workshop activity with intermittent gears
Counting Room: controlled hush, measured clock, distant rain
Dispatch Station: low machinery, sheltered canal, pipe movement
Dawn Quay: calm harbour and birds; the rain has stopped
Witness Room: quiet room and morning birds through glass
Relay House: quiet working mechanism, clear morning air
Gate Crown: high air, water below, resting metal structure
Public Forum: morning civic air and distant birds
Memory Room: open-window birds and a calm archive
